title: Exponent Rule Blanks
description: Fill in missing exponents after applying exponent rules.
learningObjective: Students apply product, quotient, and power rules for integer exponents.

feedback.defaultCorrect: Correct. The exponent rule was applied properly.
feedback.defaultIncorrect: Not yet. Decide whether to add, subtract, or multiply the exponents.
feedback.defaultEncouragement: Name the exponent rule first, then simplify.

questions.correctFeedback: Yes. x^4 times x^3 equals x^7.
questions.incorrectFeedback: For multiplying powers with the same base, add exponents.

questions.correctFeedback: Correct. y^9 divided by y^2 equals y^7.
questions.incorrectFeedback: For dividing powers with the same base, subtract exponents.

hints: A power raised to a power.
questions.incorrectFeedback: For a power raised to a power, multiply exponents.

questions.prompt: Type the rule name used here.
questions.correctFeedback: Correct. This uses the product rule.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Since the powers are multiplied, this is the product rule.
